subject: Periwinkle and warm-ivory tactile ceramic studio controls

Constraints: exactly one icon, no other symbols, no card, no UI frame, no text, no letters, no logo, no watermark, no tiny decoration. Prioritize an unambiguous silhouette at 24 px.
